event_id.description: Unique id for this event instance; used for consumer idempotency.

schema_version.description: Monotonic version of the event_type's payload schema.

tenant_id.description: Institution tenant the event belongs to.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp the source transaction committed.

correlation_id.description: Ties together events/requests belonging to the same business flow.

data.description: Event-type-specific payload, validated against its own schema.
